newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint firms vs dlr, BCE Swiss franc futures drop.
newsitem.headline: Forint firms vs dlr, BCE Swiss franc futures drop.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed firmer against the dollar while the local forex market concentrated on the slipping sterling, dealers said.
"There was a substantial number of forint/sterling deals," said Balazs Benczedi of WestLB Hungaria.
The forint closed at 155.81/86 against the dollar compared with its opening of 156.10/15.
The forint floats in the National Bank of Hungary's 4.5 percent wide intervention band, against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the Ecu.
On the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE) Swiss franc futures dropped for all maturities by 0.5 to 2 forints.
The dollar rose for four maturities, mark and sterling futures ended mixed, the Ecu finished steady or lower and the yen rose for one maturity.
The Ecu and dollar accounted for more than 14,000 contracts out of a total turnover of 19,742 contracts or 3.39 billion forints.
